item.text: The page currently waits for the dashboard API before returning any markup, so its static heading and page structure cannot form the pre-rendered shell. I’m moving that wait behind an explicit Suspense boundary and giving the shell a fallback with the same section structure.

item.text:
The page now returns a static shell with the dashboard heading while the API request runs inside a Suspense boundary. Its fallback preserves the cards, chart, and invoice sections, so the shell can be pre-rendered and streamed before the data arrives. See [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:11).

I didn’t run tests or a build. `package.json` and `package-lock.json` already had unrelated workspace changes; I left them untouched.
